headline: CLE @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 3.83 at PHI 4.33, with a projected total of 8.16. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (CLE +0.50, PHI +0.37), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.87, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +20.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Zack Wheeler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bryson Stott, Alec Bohm, Kyle Schwarber, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adolis García because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
